post.description:
The Map Hotels API allows you to display the list of hotels, returned in the search results, on a map. This API allows you to support a map-based viewing experience on your travel website. For example, you can provide a clickable map view that allows the user to look at the list of hotels in the region where the hotel search was performed to decide which hotel suits their needs. 

                You must use the session ID returned in the Get Hotel Search Results API response.

                You have the option to refine or customize the number of hotels that you want to display on the map by specifying the filters.For example, the rating filter allow the user to view only those hotels that are within the quality of service that they want.

                The API response returns the list of mapped hotels along with the basic information about the hotel, such as hotel ID, name, and the geographic coordinates of the hotel.

tags.name: Profile
tags.description: The User Profile API deals with maintaining user profile information. The User profile API gives us the ability to fetch and update user information for our system. ORXe3 Application uses Next Gen IAM application for user identity and user management.

tags.name: Hotel
tags.description: The Hotel Search API allows you to search for hotels and retrieve the list of hotels around a specific region or point of interest for the guest count (occupants), stay duration (check-in and check-out dates), and hotel preferences (such as the room rate, the star rating, and the hotel chain) specified. Using this API, you can also specify the customer's point balance and retrieve a list of reward options that the customer can avail to book a room.

tags.name: HotelDetails
tags.description: With Hotel Details API, you can retrieve a list of rooms for a specific hotel, along with their rates and content attributes.

tags.name: HotelFilters
tags.description: Get Filter Data API enables you to display a list of filters based on the filter data constructed from the search result set. Customers can use these filters to narrow down the search results to hotels that best meet their requirements. The Get Filter Data API allows you to retrieve the filter data for various filters. The filter data is constructed based on the search result set that is returned when a hotel search is initiated. For example, when a hotel search is initiated, the filter data for hotelChains filter includes a list of all those hotel chains for which the hotels are available, and the hotel count for each hotel chain.

tags.name: HotelMap
tags.description: Map Hotels API allows you to display the list of hotels and hotel details on a map view.

tags.name: HotelReviews
tags.description: Hotel Trip Advisor API allows you to retrieve the trip advisor reviews. The APi will consume HotelId from UI and will call the content service to get TripAdvisorHotelId (TId), once the TId is available a call will be made to tripadvisor api with the TId to get the TripAdvisor reviews.

tags.name: Price
tags.description: In today's competitive travel industry, the prices of hotel rooms are constantly changing. There might be scenarios where the price of a hotel room has changed since the last time you performed a search, even if it was just a few minutes ago. To ensure a seamless shopping experience, you must retrieve the latest room fare before proceeding with a booking.

tags.name: OrderDetails
tags.description: Hotel Order Details API allows you to retrieve the room booking details. For example, as an API consumer you may use this API to display the room booking details on the User Interface (UI). The booking details include the status of the booking, the payment options selected, the payment details, along with confirmation and cancellation details. The API response also includes the search criteria used to search for hotels, details of the reward option availed to pay for the booking, the room details, the breakdown of the fare, and the hotel content attributes, along with all the rules, policies, and restrictions associated with the booking.
